newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: AMARA PUBLIC OFFER 39.6 TIMES SUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: AMARA PUBLIC OFFER 39.6 TIMES SUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Hotel group Amara Holdings Ltd said in a statement on Thursday the public portion of its initial public offer (IPO) was 39.6 times subscribed.
Amara had offered a total of 132 million shares at Singapore $0.30 each. The offer comprised 79.2 million offer shares and 52.8 million placement shares. All placement shares were fully taken up.
Net proceeds of S$34.2 million from the issue will be used to fund the group's expansion in Singapore and the region.
Amara's offer, managed and underwritten by Standard Chartered Merchant Bank Asia Ltd, is expected to start trading on a "when issued" basis on August 15, 1997.
